_comment: LEVEL 4 (component, frontend): toast notification system — context provider + hook.
name: comp-toast
description: Toast notification system: ToastProvider + useToast hook (success/error/info). No extra deps.
notes: Usage: wrap app in <ToastProvider>; then const { toast } = useToast(); toast.success('Saved!'). Auto-dismisses after 4s, manual close available.
